```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LEGEND NUMBERS — helper
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
LEGEND_FILE <- "SuppFigure3_legend_numbers.txt"
cat("Supplementary Figure 3 - legend numbers\nGenerated: ", format(Sys.time()), "\n",
    file = LEGEND_FILE, sep = "")
legend_out <- function(title, x = NULL) {
  body <- if (is.null(x)) character(0) else if (is.character(x)) x
          else utils::capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE))
  txt <- c("", paste0("=== ", title, " ==="), body)
  cat(txt, sep = "\n"); cat(txt, sep = "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, append = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA — identical to the Figure 1e bile acid preparation
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Same inputs, same zero replacement and same CLR, so the values plotted here
# are the ones behind Figure 1e; this panel only splits them by postnatal week.
set.seed(42)

PBC_248_resultaten <- read_excel("PBC_248_resultaten.xlsx")
bili_ba            <- read_excel("bili.xlsx")

id_ba <- PBC_248_resultaten %>%
  select(Nr, ID, postnatal_day) %>%
  mutate(Nr = gsub(" ", "-", Nr), MM_ID = ID, ID = Nr) %>%
  select(-Nr)

merged_ba   <- id_ba %>% left_join(bili_ba, by = "ID") %>% select(-ID)
metadata_ba <- read.delim("metadata_cleaned_april.txt")
row.names(metadata_ba) <- metadata_ba$ID
metadata_infant_ba <- metadata_ba[grep("^B", rownames(metadata_ba)), ]

bili_total_ba <- metadata_infant_ba %>%
  left_join(merged_ba, by = c("MM_ID" = "MM_ID", "Postnatal_Age" = "postnatal_day"))

ba_cols <- c("GLCA-3S","TLCA-3S","LCA","UDCA","HDCA","CDCA","DCA","CA","HCA",
             "GLCA","GUDCA","GHDCA","GCDCA","GDCA","LCA-3S","GCA","TLCA",
             "TUDCA","THDCA","TCDCA","TDCA","TCA")
conjugated   <- c("GLCA-3S","TLCA-3S","GLCA","GUDCA","GHDCA","GCDCA","GDCA",
                  "GCA","LCA-3S","TLCA","TUDCA","THDCA","TCDCA","TDCA","TCA")
unconjugated <- c("LCA","UDCA","HDCA","CDCA","DCA","CA","HCA")
stopifnot(length(setdiff(ba_cols, colnames(bili_total_ba))) == 0)

clr_rows <- function(mat) {
  L <- log(as.matrix(mat)); sweep(L, 1, rowMeans(L), "-")
}

ba_raw <- bili_total_ba %>% select(ID, all_of(ba_cols)) %>% column_to_rownames("ID")
ba_raw[is.na(ba_raw)] <- 0
ba_raw <- ba_raw[rowSums(ba_raw) > 0, colSums(ba_raw) > 0, drop = FALSE]

ba_repl <- tryCatch(
  as.matrix(cmultRepl(ba_raw, label = 0, method = "CZM",
                      z.warning = 1, z.delete = FALSE, suppress.print = TRUE)),
  error = function(e) { message("cmultRepl failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
if (is.null(ba_repl)) {
  mult_repl <- function(mat) t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    pos <- x[x > 0]; if (!length(pos)) return(x)
    x[x == 0] <- min(pos) / 2; x / sum(x) }))
  ba_repl <- mult_repl(ba_raw)
}
rownames(ba_repl) <- rownames(ba_raw)

ba_clr <- clr_rows(ba_repl); rownames(ba_clr) <- rownames(ba_raw)
conj_set   <- intersect(conjugated,   colnames(ba_repl))
unconj_set <- intersect(unconjugated, colnames(ba_repl))
conj_unconj_lr <- log(rowSums(ba_repl[, conj_set,   drop = FALSE]) /
                      rowSums(ba_repl[, unconj_set, drop = FALSE]))

bili_clr_mat <- as.data.frame(ba_clr)
bili_clr_mat$conj_unconj_lr <- conj_unconj_lr[rownames(bili_clr_mat)]

legend_out("Supp 3 — bile acid table",
           sprintf("samples with any bile acid > 0: %d | species retained: %d | zero replacement: %s | coordinates: %d (22 CLR + 1 log-ratio)",
                   nrow(ba_raw), ncol(ba_raw),
                   if (exists("mult_repl")) "min/2 (fallback)" else "cmultRepl CZM",
                   ncol(bili_clr_mat)))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Plot data: the five Figure 1e coordinates, split by postnatal week
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
focus        <- c("conj_unconj_lr", "CA", "TCA", "CDCA", "TCDCA")
focus_labels <- c("Con/Uncon", "CA", "TCA", "CDCA", "TCDCA")
PROBIOTIC_COLS <- c(No = "#4a3aa7", Yes = "#199e70")
PROBIOTIC_TINT <- c(No = "#dedcef", Yes = "#d6eee5")

plot_df_week <- bili_clr_mat %>%
  rownames_to_column("ID") %>%
  select(ID, any_of(focus)) %>%
  left_join(bili_total_ba %>% select(ID, MM_ID, probiotics, week), by = "ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(probiotics), !is.na(week)) %>%
  pivot_longer(any_of(focus), names_to = "coord", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(probiotics = factor(probiotics, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
         coord      = factor(coord, levels = focus, labels = focus_labels),
         week       = factor(as.character(week), levels = as.character(1:8),
                             labels = paste0("W", 1:8))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(week))

legend_out("Supp 3 — plotted samples / infants (total)",
           plot_df_week %>% distinct(ID, MM_ID) %>%
             dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
                              n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(MM_ID)))
legend_out("Supp 3 — samples / infants per week and probiotic exposure",
           plot_df_week %>% distinct(ID, MM_ID, week, probiotics) %>%
             dplyr::group_by(week, probiotics) %>%
             dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(),
                              n_infants = dplyr::n_distinct(MM_ID), .groups = "drop"))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FDR values — taken from the Figure 1e screen, so the two figures agree
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1E_bileacid_full_screen.csv is written by the Figure 1e chunk. These are
# overall models across all weeks, Benjamini-Hochberg corrected across every
# phenotype x coordinate pair; they are shown once per facet, not per week.
SCREEN_FILE <- "1E_bileacid_full_screen.csv"

fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA",
                     ifelse(x < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("%.3f", x)))

if (file.exists(SCREEN_FILE)) {
  screen <- read.csv(SCREEN_FILE)
  lab_df <- screen %>%
    filter(Pheno == "probiotics", BileAcid %in% focus) %>%
    group_by(BileAcid) %>% slice_min(P, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
    transmute(coord = factor(BileAcid, levels = focus, labels = focus_labels),
              label = paste0("FDR = ", fmt_p(FDR)))
  legend_out("Supp 3 — overall FDR per coordinate (from the Figure 1e screen)",
             screen %>% filter(Pheno == "probiotics", BileAcid %in% focus) %>%
               transmute(BileAcid, Beta = signif(Estimate, 3),
                         P = signif(P, 3), FDR = signif(FDR, 3),
                         N_samples, N_infants))
} else {
  lab_df <- tibble(coord = factor(character(0), levels = focus_labels),
                   label = character(0))
  warning(SCREEN_FILE, " not found - run the Figure 1e chunk first; ",
          "the panel will be drawn without FDR labels.", call. = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Per-week tests (reported in the numbers file, not drawn on the figure)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Within a single week each infant contributes at most one sample in most
# weeks, so a rank-sum test is used. These are a descriptive breakdown of the
# overall models, corrected across the 5 coordinates x weeks tested.
week_tests <- plot_df_week %>%
  group_by(coord, week) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_no  = sum(probiotics == "No"),
                   n_yes = sum(probiotics == "Yes"),
                   p_value = if (dplyr::n_distinct(probiotics) == 2 &&
                                 min(table(probiotics)) >= 3)
                     suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(value ~ probiotics,
                                                  exact = FALSE)$p.value)
                     else NA_real_,
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(FDR_week = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

legend_out("Supp 3 — per-week Wilcoxon (two-sided), BH across all coordinate x week tests",
           week_tests %>% mutate(p_value = signif(p_value, 3),
                                 FDR_week = signif(FDR_week, 3)))
legend_out("Supp 3 — per-week tests summary",
           sprintf("tests performed: %d | significant at FDR < 0.05: %d",
                   sum(!is.na(week_tests$p_value)),
                   sum(week_tests$FDR_week < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Figure
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
p_bile_week <- ggplot(plot_df_week, aes(week, value)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = probiotics, colour = probiotics),
               alpha = 0.9, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = probiotics), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.1,
             shape = 16, stroke = 0,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2,
                                             jitter.height = 0,
                                             dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(data = lab_df, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.6,
            colour = "grey20") +
  facet_wrap(~ coord, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1, strip.position = "right") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = PROBIOTIC_TINT, name = "Probiotic exposure") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = PROBIOTIC_COLS, name = "Probiotic exposure") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  labs(x = "Postnatal week", y = "Log-ratio") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4),
        panel.spacing.y  = unit(0.9, "lines"))

print(p_bile_week)
ggsave("S3_bileacid_probiotics_by_week.pdf", p_bile_week, width = 9, height = 11)
cat("\n✓ Saved: S3_bileacid_probiotics_by_week.pdf and ", LEGEND_FILE, "\n", sep = "")
sessionInfo()
```
